items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. It has been actively exploited in the wild, leading to the deployment of backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, notably an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) that allows attackers to gain access to customer accounts and private data.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-94
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-50
items.summary: An Adobe security update for Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, potentially leading to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento and Adobe Commerce, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.
